description: 后翼弃兵 D30 — 步步为营，每步扩展都要确认有子力支撑

intro.popup:
每步跟着白方走，确认d4和c4推进时是否有子力在保护。
安全才能扩展。
intro.popup_en: Follow White's moves and check which pieces support each pawn advance, especially d4 and c4. Expand only when the pawns are safe.

outro.popup:
步步为营，每步推进都有支撑。
后翼弃兵是最经典的安全扩展体系。
outro.popup_en: Expand step by step, with support behind every pawn advance. The Queen's Gambit is a classic example of safe expansion.

moves.popup:
▶️ c4 — 后翼弃兵！
白方提供c4弃兵，扩大中心控制
如果黑方吃，白方得到快速发展
moves.popup_en:
▶️ c4 - The Queen's Gambit!
White offers the c-pawn to increase central influence.
If Black captures it, White can gain rapid development.

moves.popup:
▶️ e6
黑方不吃弃兵，选择巩固中心
这是后翼弃兵拒绝变例
moves.popup_en:
▶️ e6
Black declines the gambit and reinforces the center.
This is the Queen's Gambit Declined.

moves.popup:
🔑 Nf3 — 先出棋子！
白方出马，保护d4并控制e5
记住：每步推兵前先确认有子力支撑！
moves.popup_en:
🔑 Nf3 - Develop before expanding!
The knight supports d4 and controls e5.
Remember: check that a pawn is supported before advancing it.

▶️ Nf6
Black develops a knight and keeps the position balanced.

moves.popup: 🔑 <b>Nc3 — 第二个马加入中心控制。
moves.popup_en: 🔑 Nc3 - The second knight adds to White's central control.

moves.popup:
▶️ Be7
黑方象出动，准备易位
稳健的防御，不冒进
moves.popup_en:
▶️ Be7
Black develops the bishop and prepares to castle, choosing a solid setup.

moves.popup:
🔑 Bg5 — 战略牵制！
白方象钉住黑方Nf6
这有什么战略价值？
削弱黑方对中心的控制，限制黑方的反击能力。
moves.popup_en:
🔑 Bg5 - A strategic pin!
White pins Black's knight on f6.
Why is this useful?
It reduces Black's central control and limits counterplay.

moves.popup:
▶️ O-O
黑方易位，王安全
现在黑方准备好发动中心反击了
moves.popup_en:
▶️ O-O
Black castles and secures the king, preparing to challenge the center.

moves.popup:
🔑 e3 — 又一个支撑步！
白方通过e3巩固d4和c4
moves.popup_en:
🔑 e3 - Another supporting move!
White reinforces the central pawns on d4 and c4.

moves.popup:
▶️ Nbd7
黑方出马，准备c5反击
黑方在等待时机
moves.popup_en:
▶️ Nbd7
Black develops the knight and prepares the ...c5 counterbreak, waiting for the right moment.

moves.popup:
🔑 Rc1 — 车保护c4！
白方把车放到c1，在c列支援c4
这是「步步为营」的精髓：提前布好防线，让每步兵都有后援
moves.popup_en:
🔑 Rc1 - The rook supports c4!
White places the rook on the c-file behind the c4-pawn.
This is the essence of careful expansion: prepare support before advancing.

moves.popup:
▶️ c6
黑方准备推进c5，先走c6支撑
黑方也在「步步为营」地准备反击
moves.popup_en:
▶️ c6
Black supports a future ...c5 break and prepares counterplay step by step.

moves.popup:
🔑 Bd3 — 准备推e4！
白方象到d3，目的是支援e4推进
现在e4有：Bd3对角线 + Nc3 + Nf3的支撑
白方什么时候推e4才是安全的？答：等Re1也就位后！
moves.popup_en:
🔑 Bd3 - Prepare e4!
The bishop supports the planned pawn advance. e4 is already supported by Bd3, Nc3, and Nf3.
When is e4 safe? After Re1 is in place as well.

moves.popup:
▶️ dxc4
黑方换掉c4，改变局面！
为什么黑方这时候选择换？
moves.popup_en:
▶️ dxc4
Black captures the c4-pawn and changes the structure.
Why choose this moment to exchange?

moves.popup:
▶️ Bxc4
白方象吃回，迅速恢复态势
白方在c4还有一个活跃的象
moves.popup_en:
▶️ Bxc4
White recaptures with the bishop and restores the position quickly, placing an active bishop on c4.

moves.popup:
✅ Nd5！黑方最后的反击！
黑方马跳到d5，一个非常强的中心格！
• 攻击白方Bg5和c3
• 占据了d5的「空缺」
这是黑方通过「步步为营」准备的最终反击手段
双方都做到了安全扩展，局面很平衡！
moves.popup_en:
✅ Nd5 - Black's key counterplay!
The knight occupies a powerful central square and attacks Bg5 and c3.
• It fills the outpost on d5.
• It is the payoff for Black's careful preparation.
Both sides expanded safely, and the position remains balanced.
